title: Design: Bulk bar with nothing ticked looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A near-black bar with rounded corners spans the full width of the list, directly under the Active and Inactive tabs.
  • At the bar's left: a round dark grey badge with a white 0, the word "selected" in light grey, a thin upright divider, then a small blue "Deactivate" button that looks dimmed.
  • A white X sits at the right end of the bar.
  • The search and filter row now sits under the bar, and the blue New Inventory Part button is still shown at its right end.
  • A checkbox column is now the first column, with an empty square box in the header and on part A's row; the history-icon column comes next.
  • Part A's row is not shaded: nothing is ticked yet.

Step 4:

  • The dark bar and the checkbox column disappear, and the search and filter row moves back under the tabs.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R4: “Turning the mode on adds a checkbox column, 44px wide, at the left of the table, and scrolls the table back to its left edge so the column is in view.”
  • S2-R7: “While the mode is on, the bulk bar spans the full width of the list directly under the Active and Inactive tabs, and the search and filter row moves down under it.”
  • S2-R7a: “In the light theme the bulk bar is near-black (#121926), the count is white, and the word "selected" is light grey. In the dark theme the bar is white and its text is dark. Its corners are rounded 8px.”
  • S2-R7b: “From left to right the bar shows: the number of ticked rows in a round badge followed by the word "selected", a thin divider, and a blue button reading "Deactivate". The number updates as the user ticks.”
  • S2-R8: “The Deactivate button is disabled while no row is ticked. Hovering it then shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, §3 Technical Decisions, D24: “Keep "New Inventory Part" visible in bulk mode (4.3, 4.8).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
